## Description
Describe your changes in detail. What issue does this fix or what capability does it add?

## Related Issue
Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] UI / Styling refinement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the Microsoft Fluent 2 design language and project style guidelines.
- [ ] I have verified that all unit and regression tests pass (`python -m pytest tests -q`).
- [ ] I have verified the headless self-test (`python ghostline/app.py --self-test`).
- [ ] I have verified UI layout and alignment (`python tools/ui_lint.py`).
- [ ] No API keys, credentials, or personal telemetry have been introduced.
- [ ] Documentation and user guides have been updated if necessary.
